items.body_excerpt: IMO It’s just really hard to justify upper 30’s for Kessler from a team perspective. I’m interested to hear what offers are like for Duren. We know what Hartenstein just got. And Kessler has been out for a year and has never played on a winning team much less even sniffed the playoffs.
